turns.text: Thanks for coming in. I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
Okay. Setting the grade aside for a second.
I'm not setting it aside. He saw a zero on his phone, in class, before anyone called me.
If you were me, what would you do here? Genuinely.
Is Hale asking me how to do Hale's job? You gave him the zero. I want to know on what basis.
